enunciado:
An open-air cinema runs five screens along a promenade. There are 5 positions numbered 1 to 5 from left to right. Each position has exactly one item from each list, and each listed item appears once. Projectionists: Bia, Dani, Elio, Luz, Paz. Genres: Animation, Comedy, Documentary, Mystery, Western. Snacks: Gelato, Nachos, Popcorn, Pretzel, Toffee. Symbols: Arrow, Circle, Diamond, Square, Star. Sign woods: Birch, Cedar, Maple, Pine, Walnut.
1. Luz is in position 1.
2. Elio is next to Luz.
3. Paz is immediately to the right of Dani.
4. Bia is somewhere to the right of Paz.
5. Western is at the same position as Elio.
6. Comedy is next to Western.
7. Comedy is somewhere to the left of Western.
8. Animation is immediately to the right of Mystery.
9. Documentary is somewhere to the right of Animation.
10. Nachos is at the same position as Animation.
11. Toffee is immediately to the left of Nachos.
12. Popcorn is somewhere to the left of Pretzel.
13. Pretzel is somewhere to the left of Toffee.
14. Star is at the same position as Pretzel.
15. Circle is next to Star.
16. Circle is somewhere to the left of Star.
17. Arrow is immediately to the right of Square.
18. Diamond is somewhere to the right of Arrow.
19. Walnut is at the same position as Arrow.
20. Birch is immediately to the left of Walnut.
21. Cedar is somewhere to the left of Pine.
22. Pine is somewhere to the left of Birch.
For every listed item, give its position number.
verificacion_manual: Luz fija la posición 1 y su vecino Elio queda en 2. Desde ahí el bloque Dani–Paz y la posición posterior de Bia llenan las posiciones restantes. Western hereda 2 de Elio, Comedy es su vecino izquierdo y Mystery, Animation, Documentary llenan lo que queda según las pistas de orden. Nachos hereda 4 de Animation y Toffee queda en 3. Popcorn y Pretzel llenan 1 y 2 en ese orden y Gelato queda en 5. Star hereda 2 de Pretzel, Circle es su vecino izquierdo y Square, Arrow, Diamond llenan lo que queda según las pistas de orden. Walnut hereda 4 de Arrow y Birch queda en 3. Cedar y Pine llenan 1 y 2 en ese orden y Maple queda en 5.
fuente: Inventado para el HW2 con asistencia de Codex (ver AI_LOG.md).
